name: browser-use
description: Agent-plane capability: LLM-driven browser automation. Exposes navigate/act/extract tools backed by a browser-use HTTP service.
author: Nova

settings.label: browser-use service URL
settings.description: Base URL of the browser-use HTTP service. Overrides the BROWSER_USE_URL env var when set.

settings.label: Request timeout (ms)
settings.description: How long to wait for the browser-use service before aborting a tool call.

tools.name: browser.navigate
tools.description: Open a URL in a browser session and return the resulting page title and URL.

tools.name: browser.act
tools.description: Perform a natural-language action in the current browser session (click, type, scroll, submit).

instruction.description: Natural-language action, e.g. "click the Sign in button".

tools.name: browser.extract
tools.description: Extract structured data from the current page given a natural-language query and optional JSON schema.

query.description: What to extract, e.g. "all product names and prices".

schema.description: Optional JSON Schema the result should conform to.
